component_contracts.paper: Each item uses camera/write/highlight/draw/annotation; optional connection targets later ID; overview/conclusion shared; sticky-revision requires targetId and revision; return-loop requires fromId/toId and return. Child number/label/marker/icon/note use same persistent item ID and source camera.
component_contracts.generic: heading shared, item per ID; compare answer per ID; process exactly3 items and connection; evidence/recap/definition tab per ID and note when nonempty. No model or scientific-only events.

scientific_models.common: Exactly one editable id/label, no unused icon/note/text controls. Exact family fields checked in validate_model; finite/bounded values, source formulas in geometry.ts. All begin with heading.
scientific_models.orbit-phase: orbit: phase/phaseSpeed/inclination/displayInclination/sunRadius/bodyRadius/orbitRadius; diagram. Actual position, illumination and same projected orbit.
scientific_models.surface-view: same orbit controls; diagram+inspect. Same upper body enlarges with incident rays, original system shrinks, lower apparent disk remains.
scientific_models.shadow-overlap: section: phase/phaseSpeed/bodyRadius/occluderRadius/offset/offsetSpeed; inspect, no unused diagram. Standalone cross-section scales in; real circle intersection drives same mask and fraction.
scientific_models.inclined-orbit: orbit plus occluderRadius/shadowOffset; diagram. Physical inclination separate from displayed inclination; same world state/actual overlap.
scientific_models.projection-compare: orbit controls; diagram. Two projections of same 3D position; height in normalized model units, not unverified centimeters.
scientific_models.causal-compare: causal: phase/phaseSpeed/counterPhase/counterSpeed/bodyRadius/occluderRadius/offset/offsetSpeed; diagram. Two stacked distinct illumination/occlusion conditions.
scientific_models.ray-topology: rays: startX/endX/firstY/gap/count/blockers[id,x,y,radius]; diagram. Each ray terminates at nearest real intersection, result derives from reachability, current reference instance3/7.
scientific_models.condition-proof: orbit plus occluderRadius/shadowOffset; diagram and condition-opposition/condition-plane/condition-overlap each own event and independent derived truth.
